explanation: The execution contains a fault because stipulated corpus record n06-r06 was silently omitted from the upstream handoff into Job 2. The top-level corpus includes n06-r06 with need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', demand_score 5, source_id s06, and source_weight 3, and Job 2 even has a matching capability cap-compare. But Job 2's input needs and evidence_sources contain only seven records and exclude n06-r06, so the downstream output also lacks it. Because the omission is already present in Job 2's input handoffs, the evidence localizes responsibility to the upstream job, not the downstream coverage/ranking job. No function-level evidence is supplied.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus includes record_id n06-r06 with need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', demand_score 5, source_id s06, source_weight 3.
job_downstream_coverage_priority.input.capabilities includes capability_id cap-compare with the same need text, so n06-r06 was a mappable stipulated record.
job_downstream_coverage_priority.input.needs omits n06-r06 and contains seven records: n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, n06-r08.
job_downstream_coverage_priority.input.evidence_sources also omits n06-r06 and ranks seven records, jumping from n06-r05 to n06-r07.
pipeline_topology identifies job_upstream_demand_provenance as job_1 upstream and job_downstream_coverage_priority as job_2 downstream; the omission is present before Job 2 executes.
